nodes.label: Indonesian Honorific and Register Policy
nodes.rationale: Japanese honorifics remain romanized and attached to names because Indonesian kinship and courtesy terms encode different relationships; omitted honorifics are also preserved because a bare name conveys intimacy or contempt.

nodes.rationale: Transcriptions are read manually and reviewed by a second reader to record the printed text rather than normalize unexpected character-voice spellings.

nodes.label: Pixel-Keyed Page Cache

nodes.label: One-Directory Sidecar Distribution

nodes.label: Fixture Provenance
